step:start.text: New face on the board. Pick a handle you can live with, chummer. Your government name? Keep it in a lead box.
Second the lead box. I've seen SINs sold for less than a soykaf.

step:priorities.text: Five letters, A through E, and every one of 'em costs you something. Welcome to the shadows.
Put Resources on E and you'll be eating Nutrisoy out of a dumpster behind the Stuffer Shack. Ask me how I know.
Put Magic on A and the street will smell it on you before you open your mouth. Worth it.

step:metatype.text: Pick your meat. You'll be stuck in it a while.

step:magic.text: Awakened? Then hear this: the drain doesn't care how pretty your spell looks.
Totem or tradition, choose like your life depends on it. It will.

step:attributes.text: Body keeps you breathing. Quickness keeps you out of the way. Nobody ever died of too much Willpower.

step:skills.text: Can't shoot, can't talk, can't drive? Then you'd better be able to run. Fast.
Etiquette is the cheapest armor in the Sprawl. Nobody buys it.

step:edges.text: Everybody's got a flaw. The smart ones know which one will get 'em killed.

step:resources.text: Nuyen in your pocket at the start is the most nuyen you'll ever have. Spend it like it's your last.

step:contacts.text: Your fixer is not your friend. Your fixer is your fixer. Learn the difference before you learn it the hard way.

step:lifestyle.text: Low lifestyle: you'll learn which neighbours to trust. Squatter: you'll learn which ones to run from.

step:finish.text: Board's open. Don't make me write your obituary on it.
Frag it, I'll write it. I've got a template.
